g.text: Rows: recipient SST + residuals. Columns: donor ocean anomalies. One fixed full-sample model.
Same-month detrended ocean anomalies are exchanged; recipient background and residuals are retained.
Diagonal agreement is exact by construction. SST display: 1982–2022 monthly anomalies.
